units.source_zh: 家康表面上仍将上杉景胜当作敌人，全力以赴征讨会津。

paragraphs.source_zh: 中午时分，家康抵达大津，受到参议京极高次的盛情款待。高次之妻乃秀赖生母淀夫人的妹妹、秀忠之妻阿江与的姐姐。家康一直把高次看作盟友，但目前却还不便向他挑明。家康表面上仍将上杉景胜当作敌人，全力以赴征讨会津。

paragraphs.source_en: After leaving Ōtsu that same day, Ieyasu proceeded to Ishibe with a small number of close retainers. To his surprise, Natsuka Masaie, who had always been close to Mitsunari, arrived ahead of him and requested an audience. He must have been sent by Mitsunari to sound out Ieyasu’s movements.

units.source_en: After leaving Ōtsu that same day, Ieyasu proceeded to Ishibe with a small number of close retainers.
units.source_zh: 离开大津，当日，家康带了少许近臣赶赴石部。

units.source_en: To his surprise, Natsuka Masaie, who had always been close to Mitsunari, arrived ahead of him and requested an audience.
units.source_zh: 令人意外的是，素来与三成关系密切的长束正家居然抢先一步赶来，要求拜谒。

units.source_en: He must have been sent by Mitsunari to sound out Ieyasu’s movements.
units.source_zh: 他定是受三成指使，前来探察家康动静。

paragraphs.source_zh: 离开大津，当日，家康带了少许近臣赶赴石部。令人意外的是，素来与三成关系密切的长束正家居然抢先一步赶来，要求拜谒。他定是受三成指使，前来探察家康动静。

paragraphs.source_en: Natsuka Masaie’s sixty-thousand-koku castle stood at Minakuchi in Ōmi. Minakuchi lay beyond Ishibe, more than eighty li from it, so Masaie must first have entered his own castle and then doubled back to Ishibe to welcome Ieyasu. To anyone unaware of the circumstances, Masaie would indeed have appeared loyal.

units.source_en: Natsuka Masaie’s sixty-thousand-koku castle stood at Minakuchi in Ōmi.
units.source_zh: 长束正家六万石的居城就在近江水口。

units.source_en: Minakuchi lay beyond Ishibe, more than eighty li from it, so Masaie must first have entered his own castle and then doubled back to Ishibe to welcome Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 水口在石部前，距离石部有八十余里路程，故，正家定是先进入自己居城，再返回石部来迎接家康的。

units.source_en: To anyone unaware of the circumstances, Masaie would indeed have appeared loyal.
units.source_zh: 在不明内情之人看来，正家还真是忠诚。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长束正家六万石的居城就在近江水口。水口在石部前，距离石部有八十余里路程，故，正家定是先进入自己居城，再返回石部来迎接家康的。在不明内情之人看来，正家还真是忠诚。

paragraphs.source_en: Accompanied by his senior retainer Matsukawa Kinshichi, Masaie appeared before Ieyasu. “Tomorrow morning I should like to entertain the Naifu at my castle. I beg you, Naifu, to honor me with your presence.”

units.source_en: Accompanied by his senior retainer Matsukawa Kinshichi, Masaie appeared before Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 在家老松川金七陪同下，正家来到家康面前。

units.source_en: “Tomorrow morning I should like to entertain the Naifu at my castle. I beg you, Naifu, to honor me with your presence.”
units.source_zh: “在下想于明晨在居城内款待内府，请内府无论如何赏脸。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 在家老松川金七陪同下，正家来到家康面前。“在下想于明晨在居城内款待内府，请内府无论如何赏脸。”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu suddenly felt pity for Masaie. The man before him was certainly skilled at administering money and provisions, yet he was forever cautious, wavering and devoid of any mind of his own.

units.source_en: Ieyasu suddenly felt pity for Masaie.
units.source_zh: 家康忽然怜悯起正家来。

units.source_en: The man before him was certainly skilled at administering money and provisions, yet he was forever cautious, wavering and devoid of any mind of his own.

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康忽然怜悯起正家来。眼前这人，在管理钱粮方面确是好手，却总是小心翼翼，摇摆不定，毫无主见。

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall certainly come, but do not make the banquet too extravagant.”

units.source_en: “I shall certainly come, but do not make the banquet too extravagant.”
units.source_zh: “我一定会去，至于宴请，莫要太铺张了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我一定会去，至于宴请，莫要太铺张了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “It will be only a modest token of my regard.”

units.source_en: “It will be only a modest token of my regard.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “只是略表心意。”

paragraphs.source_en: Moved by pity, Ieyasu took out a short sword by Rai Kunimitsu and a long sword by Yukihira, saying, “As I recall, there are many little rivers between here and Minakuchi. Loaches must be a local specialty.” With that, he bestowed the short sword upon Masaie and the long sword upon Masaie’s son.

units.source_en: Moved by pity, Ieyasu took out a short sword by Rai Kunimitsu and a long sword by Yukihira, saying, “As I recall, there are many little rivers between here and Minakuchi. Loaches must be a local specialty.”
units.source_zh: 家康心下可怜，于是取出来国光短刀和行平长刀，道：“我记得从这里到水口一带，有许多小河，泥鳅该算是这一带名产吧。”

units.source_en: With that, he bestowed the short sword upon Masaie and the long sword upon Masaie’s son.
units.source_zh: 说着，他把短刀赐予了正家，长刀赐予正家之子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康心下可怜，于是取出来国光短刀和行平长刀，道：“我记得从这里到水口一带，有许多小河，泥鳅该算是这一带名产吧。”说着，他把短刀赐予了正家，长刀赐予正家之子。

paragraphs.source_en: Overwhelmed by the favor, Masaie withdrew in trepidation. It was already dusk. Though Masaie was on horseback, it would likely be night before he reached home. At that thought, Ieyasu was suddenly startled: Masaie had come all this way to arrange tomorrow morning’s banquet, yet he could not even say what he intended to serve. What could that mean?

units.source_en: Overwhelmed by the favor, Masaie withdrew in trepidation.
units.source_zh: 正家诚惶诚恐退了下去。

units.source_en: It was already dusk. Though Masaie was on horseback, it would likely be night before he reached home.
units.source_zh: 时值黄昏，正家虽然骑着马，但回家恐已是夜里了。

units.source_en: At that thought, Ieyasu was suddenly startled: Masaie had come all this way to arrange tomorrow morning’s banquet, yet he could not even say what he intended to serve. What could that mean?

ja.t: にできなかった。これはいったい

units.source_zh: 家康想到此，忽然一惊：为了明晨的宴请，正家特意赶来，可究竟拿什么来招待他，竟说不出口，这到底意味着什么？

paragraphs.source_zh: 正家诚惶诚恐退了下去。时值黄昏，正家虽然骑着马，但回家恐已是夜里了。家康想到此，忽然一惊：为了明晨的宴请，正家特意赶来，可究竟拿什么来招待他，竟说不出口，这到底意味着什么？

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu beckoned to Torii Shintarō and ordered in a low voice, “Go and find out exactly how many attendants Masaie has brought.”

units.source_en: Ieyasu beckoned to Torii Shintarō and ordered in a low voice, “Go and find out exactly how many attendants Masaie has brought.”
units.source_zh: 家康向鸟居新太郎招了招手，小声命令道：“你去打探一下正家究竟带了多少随从。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康向鸟居新太郎招了招手，小声命令道：“你去打探一下正家究竟带了多少随从。”

paragraphs.source_en: Torii Shintarō understood at once and immediately hurried after him. Upon reaching the bank of the Shirachi River beyond the post station, Shintarō saw Masaie join some seventy or eighty retainers, and immediately returned to report.

units.source_en: Torii Shintarō understood at once and immediately hurried after him.
units.source_zh: 鸟居新太郎心领神会，立刻追了出去。

units.source_en: Upon reaching the bank of the Shirachi River beyond the post station, Shintarō saw Masaie join some seventy or eighty retainers, and immediately returned to report.
units.source_zh: 追到驿站外白知川河滩上，新太郎看见正家与七八十名家臣合到一处，立刻回来报告。

paragraphs.source_zh: 鸟居新太郎心领神会，立刻追了出去。追到驿站外白知川河滩上，新太郎看见正家与七八十名家臣合到一处，立刻回来报告。

paragraphs.source_en: “He had his attendants wait for him over by the riverbank?”

units.source_en: “He had his attendants wait for him over by the riverbank?”
units.source_zh: “他让随从们在河滩那边等着他？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “他让随从们在河滩那边等着他？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. But why would he leave them outside the post station? What a strange man.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
But why would he leave them outside the post station?
units.source_zh: 可他为何要把随从带到驿站外面呢？

units.source_en: What a strange man.”
units.source_zh: 真是个怪人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。可他为何要把随从带到驿站外面呢？真是个怪人。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How far has Masaie gone?”

units.source_en: “How far has Masaie gone?”
units.source_zh: “正家走了多远？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正家走了多远？”

paragraphs.source_en: “More than eight li.”

units.source_en: “More than eight li.”
units.source_zh: “八里开外。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “八里开外。”

paragraphs.source_en: “There is still time...”

units.source_en: “There is still time...”
units.source_zh: “还有时间……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “还有时间……”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu sank into concentrated thought. At the Hour of the Dog, he suddenly rose and ordered the troops to depart Ishibe that very night. He must have feared that if the great host were attacked at night while unprepared in Ishibe, the consequences would be unthinkable. But on what grounds had he inferred that an attack was coming? Shintarō could not fathom it, however hard he thought.

units.source_en: Ieyasu sank into concentrated thought. At the Hour of the Dog, he suddenly rose and ordered the troops to depart Ishibe that very night.
units.source_zh: 家康凝神思虑起来，到了戌时，他忽然起身，命令部队连夜从石部出发。

paragraphs.source_en: “Quickly—the moon will soon rise. A moment’s delay will bring disaster.” Ieyasu said this to Shintarō. Shintarō immediately sent someone to summon the palanquin bearers.

units.source_en: Only after the palanquin had crossed Sunagawa Bridge did Ieyasu finally show his face. He looked up at the sky and called toward the rear of the palanquin, “Who is carrying the back?”

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Tadakatsu ordered the Mizuno, Sakai, Naruse, and other contingents to light their fuses, while the remaining soldiers deployed across the moonlit riverbank and raised a thunderous battle cry. The sudden report of guns and cannon shattered the stillness of dawn.
